messages:
kevin_sales: Quick swarm request — Prospect 'Helio' POC seeing slow TTFT (~1.7s steady, spikes to 3s under ramp) and intermittent 429s. They asked for a firm POC price and returned a security questionnaire. Can we triage?

ana_se: Got it. Are they on Hosted or asked for Dedicated? Also need sample request, concurrency, avg tokens.

kevin_sales: Hosted trial keys. They ran 30 workers with bursts and ~100 token prompts. Sample run: 
kevin_sales: ```
$ time curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-TEST" -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"Summarize...","max_tokens":120}'
real    0m1.72s
```

lee_ops: Two quick suspects: (1) router batching is optimizing throughput and creating larger batches under parallelism, which raises TTFT; (2) KV/prefix cache misses — their prompts vary a lot.

priya_ml: Reproduced similar issue with varied system messages. Cache hit-rate dropped to ~15% and added ~0.8s per request on average. If they move static context into prefix caching, it helps.

ana_se: For pricing I suggest offering a short Dedicated evaluation (7-14 days) with a POC credit and fixed per-token rate for the reserved window. Jordan/sales to draft numbers.

lee_ops: Immediate mitigations on Hosted: lower max_batch_latency, set routing_policy: low_latency for the API key, enable prefix prewarm. Client recommendations: small connection pool, client-side pacing/backoff on 429.

priya_ml: Config snippet to propose to them:
```yaml
api_key_configs:
  helio_poc_key:
    routing_policy: low_latency
    batching:
      max_batch_size: 8
      max_batch_latency_ms: 12
    cache:
      prefix_prewarm: true
```

sam_security: On security questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 summary and KMS details for Hosted. For customer-managed keys and isolated audit logs recommend Redwood Private (VPC). I can prepare an FAQ excerpt.

infra-bot: Note: No active platform incidents.

kevin_sales: Action items: (1) Ask Helio to run a paced test with the client tweaks and send logs, (2) propose Dedicated eval + pricing blurb, (3) forward SQ items to sam_security for answers.

ana_se: I'll draft the runbook for them: how to measure first-token latency, what to change client-side, and the config sample.

kevin_sales: Thanks — I'll follow up with dates for a Dedicated trial if they want it. :thumbsup:
